"""Independent TensorFlow extractive-QA graph; synthetic weights only."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from transformers import ElectraConfig,TFElectraForQuestionAnswering

OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'tiny-electra';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
config=ElectraConfig(vocab_size=32,embedding_size=16,hidden_size=32,intermediate_size=64,
    num_attention_heads=4,num_hidden_layers=2,max_position_embeddings=64,hidden_dropout_prob=0.,attention_probs_dropout_prob=0.)
model=TFElectraForQuestionAnswering(config)
ids=np.array([[2,5,6,3,7,8,9,10,3]],np.int32);mask=np.ones_like(ids);types=np.array([[0,0,0,0,1,1,1,1,1]],np.int32)
inputs={'input_ids':ids,'attention_mask':mask,'token_type_ids':types}
model(**{k:tf.constant(v) for k,v in inputs.items()},training=False)
rng=np.random.default_rng(6170)
for w in model.weights:
    values=rng.normal(0,0.03,w.shape).astype(np.float32)
    if w.name.endswith('gamma:0'):values+=1
    w.assign(values)
result=model(**{k:tf.constant(v) for k,v in inputs.items()},training=False)
model.save_pretrained(OUT,safe_serialization=False)
np.savez(OUT/'reference.npz',**inputs,start_logits=result.start_logits.numpy(),end_logits=result.end_logits.numpy())
(OUT/'weights.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'name':w.name,'shape':list(w.shape)} for w in model.weights],indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(model.weights),flush=True)
